title: Device Bridge
description: Settings of the device bridge, which gives programs in the container access to serial ports and USB devices of the computer where the browser runs.

showPanel.title: Show the Devices panel
showPanel.description: Put the Devices panel into the left sidebar. The menu item View → Show Devices Panel changes this same setting. Hiding the panel detaches no device. The change takes effect at once.

showMenu.title: Show the Devices menu
showMenu.description: Add a Devices menu to the menu bar of the lab, with the commands of the extension. The change takes effect at once.

defaultBaudRate.title: Default baud rate
defaultBaudRate.description: The baud rate a serial port gets when it is added. A port that is already in the Devices panel keeps its baud rate. The Settings dialog of the port replaces this value.

defaultDataBits.title: Default data bits
defaultDataBits.description: The number of data bits a serial port gets when it is added. A port that is already in the Devices panel keeps its value. The Settings dialog of the port replaces this value.

defaultParity.title: Default parity
defaultParity.description: The parity a serial port gets when it is added. A port that is already in the Devices panel keeps its value. The Settings dialog of the port replaces this value.

defaultStopBits.title: Default stop bits
defaultStopBits.description: The number of stop bits a serial port gets when it is added. A port that is already in the Devices panel keeps its value. The Settings dialog of the port replaces this value.

defaultOnOpen.title: Default action when a program opens the port
defaultOnOpen.description: The action that runs on a serial port each time a program opens its virtual device, set when the port is added. A port that is already in the Devices panel keeps its action. The Settings dialog of the port replaces this value.
